meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 你让它处理 git 时,它会先判断请求属于提交、变基还是查历史,并行读取状态、最近 30 条提交和分支信息,识别仓库的提交风格与语言,再把改动拆成多条原子提交并执行。
howto.when: 任何 git 操作都会接管:当你提到「commit」「rebase」「squash」等关键词,或问某段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的、哪个提交引入的时触发。

say.text: 把现在的改动提交一下,按模块拆成多条
say.note: 它会先分析仓库风格再规划拆分

say.text: 帮我 rebase 整理一下这个分支的历史
say.note: 会先看分支是否已推送再决定改写策略

say.text: 这个函数是谁写的?什么时候改的?
say.note: 进入历史查找模式,定位相关提交

howto.what_en: When you ask for git work, it first detects a commit, rebase, or history-lookup request, reads status, the last 30 commits and branch info in parallel, learns the repo's commit style, then splits changes into atomic commits.
howto.when_en: Takes over for any git operation: when you mention 'commit', 'rebase' or 'squash', or ask who wrote a line, when a change was added, or which commit introduced it.

say_en.text: Commit my current changes, split into several commits.
say_en.note: It detects repo style first, then plans the split.

say_en.text: Rebase and clean up this branch's history.
say_en.note: It checks if the branch is pushed before rewriting.

say_en.text: Who wrote this function and when did it change?
